content.title: How to watch St. John’s vs. Duke men’s basketball: Sweet 16 TV channel and streaming options for March 27
content.text: The No. 5-seed St. John’s Red Storm (30-6) head into a Sweet 16 matchup against the No. 1 Duke Blue Devils (34-2) on Friday at 7:10 p.m. ET as the NCAA Tournament continues at Capital One Arena airing on CBS.How to watch St. John’s Red Storm vs. Duke Blue Devils Venue: Capital One Arena Time: 7:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: CBS Watching in person?
